author: Baresimo

title: Free version is good but not great
body:
Works well and helps me keep track on my workout. I do wish that the dashboard would update immediately after I plot in my registration - it seems that I sometimes have to quit and re-open the app for that to happen.

I would probably be willing to pay for the app, if it was a one time payment. I hate taking out subscriptions.
